title: Lava Viper 2012
description: U.S. Marines with 2nd Battalion, 3rd Marine Regiment are conducting a safety brief and practice run at a range during Lava Viper in Pohakuloa Training Area, Jan. 15, 2012. Lava Viper is a battalion level combined arms training exercise to better prepare Marines for upcoming deployments. Produced by Lance Cpl. Robert Bush. Available in high definition.
